name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Separately authored solid Heart follows the slim V with a slight outward convex bow. Mirrored quadratic lower flanks and a compact tip are tangent-aligned without inward inflections or a broad belly. The established upper lobes and notch are retained. Bounds x=2.4..21.6, y=3.25..20.75 remain centered. No interior counters or strokes. Not owner-approved.
